    """
    Check if a field is a scalar field.
    
    A scalar field is a field that is not a list, dictionary, or a model.
    """
    return (
        field.shape == Shape.SINGLETON
        and not (lenient_issubclass(field.type_, BaseModel) or 
                 # Check if the field type is a union of models
                 (getattr(field.type_, '__origin__', None) == Union and
